calls.video_title: 4 AI Stocks to Buy After NVIDIA's $1 Trillion Comeback
calls.thesis: BUY first tracked (collab with The Motley Fool's Neil). Applied Materials is his second pick: wafer-fab equipment market growth expected above 30% in 2027 and continuing into 2028, with advanced packaging — one of the cycle's biggest constraints — expected to grow north of 90% next year; Applied leads in that step of the process.
calls.base_case: WFE spending keeps growing through 2027-28 as the AI ecosystem keeps buying equipment.
calls.bull_case: Advanced-packaging demand stays the bottleneck and Applied takes a growing share of it.
calls.bear_case: Equipment cycle turns and chipmakers cut capex.

calls.video_title: Sales are Booming for Applied Materials | AMAT Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked) - a buying opportunity, but low conviction: the forward P/E has fallen back to ~15 (where 2026 started) against ~31% expected EPS growth and a >31% operating margin, yet his DCF fair value of $357 is barely below the ~$370 price, so the two methods disagree.
calls.base_case: Management forecasts 30% demand growth in 2027 and doubling system output by 2028; $9.2bn cash vs under $6bn long-term debt funds the expansion.
calls.bull_case: AI-driven demand keeps compounding and the multiple re-rates toward the growth rate.
calls.bear_case: DCF says roughly fairly valued; the P/E case may already be priced in.
